title: SHA3 completeness: sha3-384 and sha3-512
description:
Add sha3-384 and sha3-512 to wolfssl and kcapi providers.

wolfssl_sha.c currently supports sha3-256 (via wc_Sha3_256_*) but not sha3-384 or sha3-512. kcapi_hash.c has sha3-256 but not sha3-384/sha3-512. The DESIGN.md algorithm coverage table implicitly shows a gap; NIST FIPS 202 approves all four SHA-3 variants.

What needs to be done:
1. Add C2D_SHA3_384 and C2D_SHA3_512 type constants to wolfssl_sha.c; implement sess_init/update/final/free using wc_Sha3_384_*/wc_Sha3_512_*; register two new algo_ops structs
2. Add sha3-384 and sha3-512 to kcapi_hash.c following the sha3-256 pattern
3. Add SHA3-384 and SHA3-512 NIST FIPS 202 known-answer vectors to tests/vectors/sha3.h
4. Add sha3-384 and sha3-512 test cases to test_chardev.c
5. Update DESIGN.md algorithm coverage table
